runners_data.name: Giant Haystacks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent chase form, ideal position to track uncontested leader and strike late
runners_data.comment: Top-rated of these over fences; should be involved if the ground doesn't deteriorate
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler is 0-3 in chases and rated 95; kept on well for a 2.75l fourth of 14 in Down Royal beginners' on latest (19.5f, gd-yld); place claims again if sees out this longer trip but that's not guaranteed.

runners_data.name: Butterfly Mountain
runners_data.note: Sole pace angle gives tactical advantage but very modest form profile raises winning ability questions
runners_data.spotlight: Very modest form in two points and three maiden hurdles; best watched on chase debut.

runners_data.name: A Snow White Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage but strong recent chase form and Mullins yard gives confidence
runners_data.comment: 66-1 winner at Ballinrobe last May, fourth in a chase last time her best effort since then
runners_data.spotlight: 66-1 winner on Rules debut in a 4yo hurdle at Ballinrobe (16.5f, good) last May; close fourth in 15.5f novice handicap chase off 102 here on penultimate; well beaten back over hurdles at Downpatrick latest; stamina a query for this trip.

runners_data.name: Joshua Chamberlain
runners_data.note: Back from 16-day break after long layoff, hold-up style not ideal for likely tactical affair
runners_data.spotlight: 1-11 over timber and rated 95; back from mammoth layoff with 32l defeat in Punchestown handicap hurdle 16 days ago; sharper now and related to chase winners so could take to this discipline.

runners_data.name: Mount Shenshan
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with poor chase record, best form on softer ground than today's good conditions
runners_data.comment: Yet to win over fences but decent runs the last twice; not so good over hurdles since
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdles winner is 0-10 over fences; beaten 12.5l off 92 in Wexford handicap chase on latest (25.5f, gd-yld); best form has come on soft and heavy ground; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Parkgarve
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits pace scenario perfectly, returning to chasing after September effort at Downpatrick
runners_data.comment: 11-race maiden; some okay runs in defeat; not the biggest surprise to see him feature
runners_data.spotlight: Promise without winning over hurdles and rated 96 in that sphere; weakened after the third last fence on sole chase outing at Downpatrick (2m2f) last September; has hinted this sort of trip might suit on occasion but much more needed.

runners_data.name: Are You Busy
runners_data.note: Chase debutante with solid hurdle form, hold-up style faces pace disadvantage but breeding suggests chasing ability
runners_data.comment: Below form all handicap runs; reportedly bled last time so has a bit to prove now
runners_data.spotlight: Chase debutante; 1-8 over hurdles and rated 98; bred to make a chaser and trip and ground should be fine for her here; respectable run over hurdles at Wexford latest (3m, gd-yld); tongue tie goes on; place claims.

runners_data.name: Huntsgrove
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner off 190-day break with poor recent chase form, hard to recommend on evidence
runners_data.spotlight: 1-11 over hurdles and rated 100; tailed off in all three previous starts over fences and similar story last two starts in novice hurdles; lacks a recent run and others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Journey So Far
runners_data.note: Consistent fader in finish makes tactical scenario even more challenging for back-marker approach
runners_data.comment: Yet to get any closer than 22l to the winner in nine starts under rules'
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden is rated 106 after four chase runs, the best of which was a 22l seventh in strong Fairyhouse beginners' chase in December (2m, soft, RPR 116); poor twice since over fences and hurdles but big claims on that Fairyhouse run in this company.

runners_data.name: Big Island
runners_data.note: Back from 285-day layoff with poor chase record, prominent style helps but fitness questions loom
runners_data.comment: Went close here in April 2025; fell two out at Tramore when with winning chance in August
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler; 0-8 over fences and rated 97; fell when holding every chance in a C&D handicap chase when last seen last August (good); has gone well fresh and not discounted.

runners_data.name: Quiet In Bresil
runners_data.note: Consistent fader with maiden status, hold-up approach faces double disadvantage in tactical contest
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden; 0-3 over hurdles and rated 93; never involved on chase debut at Kilbeggan on latest; major improvement required.

races.paceDynamic: Butterfly Mountain is the sole confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable gallop that won't stretch the field early. Giant Haystacks and Parkgarve from prominent positions can track the leader without pressure, while the bulk of the field including A Snow White Park, Joshua Chamberlain, Mount Shenshan, Are You Busy, Huntsgrove, Journey So Far and Quiet In Bresil will settle behind. With no pace pressure early, this sets up as a tactical affair that will come alive from the second last fence. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the soft pace and kick from close range rather than hold-up horses facing a sprint finish from too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Butterfly Mountain sets manageable fractions and the prominent trackers get first run
scenarios.body: Giant Haystacks and Parkgarve can position perfectly behind the leader and have enough in reserve to outkick the hold-up horses in the straight. The soft early pace allows them to conserve energy for a sustained drive from the second last.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts Home
scenarios.trigger: If Butterfly Mountain gets away with very slow fractions and no serious challenge materialises until late
scenarios.body: The front runner builds an unassailable advantage through weak splits and has enough left to resist late challenges. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up when the pace finally quickens.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely searching from halfway as prominent runners press forward
scenarios.body: A Snow White Park or Are You Busy benefit from a truly run race that sets up their finishing kicks perfectly. The early pace setters pay for their efforts when the best closers unleash devastating late runs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race collapses into a messy sprint finish where early position matters less
scenarios.body: Journey So Far or Mount Shenshan find the tactical nature suits their profiles better than expected. Class horses fail to fire and a willing battler prevails in a scrambled finish.

watchPoints.text: Butterfly Mountain could steal this if given uncontested lead throughout - front runners dangerous at Tramore
A Snow White Park needs genuine pace to unleash finishing kick - watch for early tempo development
Giant Haystacks and Parkgarve could dominate if tracking leader smoothly into straight - prominent pair to follow
Journey So Far and Quiet In Bresil both fade in finish - avoid if race becomes sprint from last fence
Are You Busy making chase debut for shrewd Sweeney yard - market support could signal confidence in newcomer

races.name: Tramore Derby July 7th Beginners Chase

runners_data.name: Costacurta
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 120 rating returning from 214-day break but bred for fences and trained by Henry De Bromhead
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten three times under a penalty in novice hurdles after winning his maiden but rated 120 in that scene and he's bred for fences; every chance, for all that he would probably prefer a longer trip.

runners_data.name: Mercury Mission
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid chase form, placed both completed fence starts and carries useful 122 RPR
runners_data.comment: Fine effort when second at 80-1 at Clonmel, this looks like a more competitive race
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner with a mark of 113; placed in both completed starts over fences, last time running as well as he was entitled to at Wexford; in the mix.

runners_data.name: Endless Talking
runners_data.note: Usually held up but won by leading at Downpatrick three weeks ago, suggesting tactical flexibility
runners_data.comment: Met interference when third behind the market leaders at Kilbeggan, strong chance now
runners_data.spotlight: Maintained his progress over hurdles with a 20l success from the front in a 2m3f maiden at Downpatrick three weeks ago (good); the RPR he posted reads well in this company and he won a point, so fences shouldn't present a problem.

runners_data.name: Bannow Blaze
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with consistent hurdle form, 154 days since last run could be a concern for sharpness
runners_data.comment: 2lb rise for recent Cork second looks harsh; still prone to jumping errors
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent hurdler who was in good form for the most part of last year, winning a 2m handicap at Wexford in October; there are successful chasers in the family.

runners_data.name: Jerrari
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose form has declined this year, poor chase debut at Wexford suggests struggles over fences
runners_data.comment: Won twice over hurdles, could make a summer chaser, will probably need to gain experience
runners_data.spotlight: Won two good-ground handicap hurdles last summer but hasn't recaptured that level of form this year, including on recent chase debut at Wexford (50-1).

runners_data.name: Nelson Muntz
runners_data.note: Prominent/leader but tailed off in recent runs after 72-day break, needs to recapture old form
runners_data.spotlight: Has some useful form over hurdles and on the Flat, though has been tailed off in both disciplines since returning from a break of 72 days; if back on song, he would have a part to play in this company on chase debut.

runners_data.name: Boston Jury
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but offered little on fence debut, hard to recommend after disappointing hurdle form
runners_data.spotlight: Became disappointing over hurdles after winning his maiden and he offered very little on switch to fences last October; hard to warm to.

runners_data.name: Game Phoenix
runners_data.note: Prominent style but longstanding maiden with inferior hurdle form, 7lb claimer takes off useful weight
runners_data.comment: Placed in good-ground maiden hurdles last summer, absent since chase debut in October
runners_data.spotlight: Longstanding maiden; inferior hurdler to some in here and she was tailed off in her previous chase.

races.paceDynamic: Nelson Muntz will likely lead from the front with his prominent style, though his recent tailed-off runs create uncertainty about his early pace. Costacurta and Game Phoenix should track close behind in the early stages, while the majority of this field - Mercury Mission, Endless Talking, Bannow Blaze, Jerrari, and Boston Jury - all prefer hold-up tactics. With only one confirmed front-runner and potentially weak early pace, this sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses who can get into contention late. The race strongly favours horses with proven finishing kicks who can benefit from a steady gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Nelson Muntz sets modest early fractions or fades from the front
scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian allowing the closers to wind up their finishing kicks in the straight. Mercury Mission, Endless Talking and Bannow Blaze all have the class and style to capitalize on this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Costacurta Controls From Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Costacurta tracks Nelson Muntz closely and takes over at the right moment
scenarios.body: His 120 rating and De Bromhead training gives him the quality to dictate from a forward position. The Henry De Bromhead yard's tactical acumen could see Darragh O'Keeffe time his move perfectly to deny the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Endless Talking Repeats Downpatrick
scenarios.trigger: If the recent Downpatrick winner reproduces his front-running tactics from three weeks ago
scenarios.body: Endless Talking could surprise by going forward early rather than waiting, using his 20-length winning momentum. This aggressive approach might steal a march on horses expecting to pick him up late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Nelson Muntz Returns Form
scenarios.trigger: If Nelson Muntz bounces back to his useful hurdle form after recent poor runs
scenarios.body: The David Harry Kelly-trained front-runner could sustain a strong gallop throughout and prove too tough to pass. His proven ability at this level would make him hard to peg back if firing on all cylinders.

watchPoints.text: Nelson Muntz's early pace-setting - if he's sluggish or pulls up early, it creates a crawl that massively favours closers
Costacurta's fitness after 214 days off - any signs of rustiness could end De Bromhead's chances quickly
Endless Talking's tactical approach - whether Cromwell instructs aggressive front-running or patient hold-up riding
Mercury Mission's jumping fluency - his Wexford second suggests competence but needs to maintain that standard
Game Phoenix's 7lb claim with Dylan Whelan - the weight allowance could make her competitive despite maiden status

races.name: Walsh King Accountants Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Lady Doyanne
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making chase debut for in-form De Bromhead team with good recent hurdles form suggesting readiness
runners_data.comment: Won a 2m1f Wexford maiden last August, stablemate Sense Of Occasion appeals more
runners_data.spotlight: Wexford maiden hurdle winner last August (2m1f, gd-yld); not a bad run in handicap hurdle at Clonmel latest; turns her hand to chasing now and pedigree suggests she'll take to this game; yard in form; interesting.

runners_data.name: Femme Magnifique
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer off 90-day break switching to new trainer with poor recent strike rate
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper and hurdles winner for Willie Mullins in 2023-24; failed to add tom her tally for Paul Kiely last year and off since an okay run at Navan in February; worth a market check on first run for Harry Kelly.

runners_data.name: Presenting Lad
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with course win but poor recent form and modest return last time suggests decline
runners_data.comment: Veteran returns from 7 months' absence off much-reduced mark
runners_data.spotlight: Two chase wins in 2024 (including a novice over C&D) but it has been slim pickings since then; no joy in 2025 and modest run at Wexford on return from a break on latest; on a dangerous mark but needs a revival.

runners_data.name: Polly Poppins
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent course record and well-handicapped after 232-day break
runners_data.spotlight: Best two runs of her career have come here; beaten a head in 16.5f (good) handicap hurdle last August; 3.25l third in C&D handicap chase when last seen in October and 1lb lower now; could go well if ready after 232 day absence.

runners_data.name: Be Fierce
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needs testing ground and struggles on good surface based on winning conditions
runners_data.comment: Bagged second hurdling win back from a break by a head last time; up 5lb and this harder
runners_data.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Punchestown in January (2m, sft-hvy); his C&D novice chase win came on testing ground too and it was yielding when he won here over hurdles; goes well fresh so lack of a recent run isn't a concern but could do with some rain.

runners_data.name: Itsalonglongroad
runners_data.note: Front runner with outstanding course record but 40-day break and poor recent efforts are concerning
runners_data.comment: Old boy has won 12 races in all under both codes, but pushing on now and looks opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran; five-time chase winner including three over C&D; last won here last August off 99 and 3lb lower now; recent efforts have been underwhelming, however, and blinkers are reached for.

runners_data.name: Ballybrittas
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid chase form but beaten heavily last twice at higher level
runners_data.spotlight: Point and Limerick maiden hurdle winner (16.5f, good) has finished runner up in two of his seven starts over fences; beaten 17.5l on last two starts at Kilbeggan and Killarney at around 2m4f; drop back in trip here a plus; rated 10lb higher over timber; could go well.

runners_data.name: Typical Thomas
runners_data.note: Front runner returning after 347-day absence with poor fresh record despite class advantage
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time chase winner but losing run stretches back to October 2023; off since okay run on the Flat at Listowel last September; poor record when fresh; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Stuntman Steve
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse getting first-time cheekpieces and favoured good ground after poor recent form
runners_data.comment: Hard to fancy on chasing evidence but this Irish raider is well treated on his hurdle form
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time hurdles winner is 0-5 in chases; out of form in 2026 but has yet to get his favoured good ground; could go well in first-time cheekpieces with conditions to suit.

runners_data.name: Bynx
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with course hurdles win but struggles to translate form to chasing
runners_data.comment: Better NH performer but Navan third over this trip last autumn gives her claims; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdles winner (including here) is 1-4 over fences; that win came at Wexford (2m, good) off 7lb lower last August; out of depth in Listed hurdle latest but this more suitable and she goes well here; not out of this.

runners_data.name: Party President
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse changing stables after losing form and making chase debut off long break
runners_data.comment: Ran respectably back here 25 days ago when given every chance and finishing fifth
runners_data.spotlight: Won back-to-back races over hurdles last year but lost form subsequently and has since left Tony Mullins; off since January and best watched on stable and chase debut.

runners_data.name: Kingdom Calling
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with one shock win but no form since and making chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Shock Listowel maiden hurdle winner in August 2024; hasn't come close to replicating that form since and leap of faith required to fancy him on his chase debut; 3lb wrong.

races.paceDynamic: Typical Thomas and Itsalonglongroad are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, with Typical Thomas likely to press harder given his fresh return from a long break. Lady Doyanne and Polly Poppins will track prominently behind this pace battle, creating an honest gallop over the trip. The sustained early tempo will stretch the field and expose the stamina reserves of the hold-up horses in the closing stages. This honest pace strongly favours prominent runners who can position close enough to strike without getting embroiled in the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Pace Sustained
scenarios.trigger: If Typical Thomas and Itsalonglongroad maintain a solid gallop without collapsing
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can track the pace without overexerting and have enough left to capitalise when the leaders weaken. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground over this intermediate trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too hard early and fade dramatically in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where hold-up horses can unleash their finishing kicks. Late runners benefit from the shortened effective distance and tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Itsalonglongroad Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran settles better than Typical Thomas and controls the tempo throughout
scenarios.body: His course experience and proven ability at the trip allows him to dictate terms and kick clear. Other prominent runners get the ideal tow but struggle to pass the local specialist.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Typical Thomas Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the James Fahey-trained leader overcomes his poor fresh record and sustains his gallop
scenarios.body: His class advantage shows despite the long absence and he proves too strong from the front. The honest pace plays to his strengths and nullifies the closers.

watchPoints.text: Typical Thomas returning after 347 days with historically poor fresh record could collapse if going too hard early
Be Fierce and Party President both making debuts for new connections off lengthy breaks with unclear fitness levels
Itsalonglongroad at age 12 showing recent decline may not have the stamina reserves for sustained front-running battle
Lady Doyanne represents powerful De Bromhead stable making chase debut with immediate winning chance if taking to fences
Polly Poppins returning after 232 days but has shown best form fresh at this course previously

races.name: Success Days At Kilbarry Lodge Stud Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Poetic Twist
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with highest RPR but faces traffic dangers in congested early positions with four others wanting similar spots
runners_data.spotlight: Receiving weight off the winner when beaten a neck at Killarney (2m6f maiden) but no disgrace in that effort and the front two were clear; strong claims.

runners_data.name: Ice Breeze Baby
runners_data.note: Debutant with strong connections whose running style remains unknown, making market moves crucial for assessment
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to point winner That's Me; dam was fourth in a point and related to winning jumpers; the market can guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Straightupsideways
runners_data.note: Fallen in both point-to-points with unknown style, making her highly unreliable despite Flanagan booking
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten when falling in her two points and makes limited appeal on hurdle debut.

runners_data.name: Luciole Des Bordes
runners_data.note: Prominent type who raced too freely last time, now fitted with hood to settle better under champion jockey
runners_data.comment: Runner up both starts this season, this longer trip should help, give another chance to
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in two bumpers before racing too freely and not getting home in the latest at Clonmel (2m4f, yielding); no surprise to see a hood turned to and major player if giving herself a chance.

runners_data.name: Giorgia Rose
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who fades in finish, concerning over this extended trip despite tongue-tie being retained from last run
runners_data.comment: Kapgarde mare 0-5 in points but showed ability, tongue tied for Rules' bow, check market
runners_data.spotlight: Competitive in points but was a tailed-off last in a Clonmel bumper, in which a below par Luciole Des Bordes was ahead of her; the tongue-tie tried then is now joined by cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Mysilverriverfeale
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse showing gradual improvement with hood fitted, suited by strong pace and 18-day break
runners_data.spotlight: Some signs of progress when beaten 18l in a 2m6f maiden at Killarney only recently but she'll need more again.

runners_data.name: Rebel Queen
runners_data.note: Lone pace-setter carrying 8lbs less than rivals, giving her tactical advantage if allowed uncontested lead
runners_data.spotlight: Bit better when beaten about 11l in a Limerick maiden but others have achieved plenty more.

runners_data.name: Muted Melody
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with hood and blinkers fitted who stayed on strongly last time, perfectly positioned for pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Fair level of ability in bumpers; interesting switched to hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise in bumpers; got behind early (started slowly) before staying on into third in an 18-runner maiden at Clonmel (2m, good to yielding) and that's something to build on; blinkers join the usual hood.

runners_data.name: Northernlightsky
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 153-day absence with modest form figures, facing sharp competition for early position
runners_data.comment: Three runs in bumpers don't suggest she'll feature here; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Modest point form and hasn't shown a lot more in three bumpers.

runners_data.name: Howyasox
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor form across all disciplines, making her an outsider despite tactical advantage
runners_data.comment: Held every chance when falling on her point debut but has fared less well since
runners_data.spotlight: No obvious claims on what she's shown in points, two bumpers and a maiden hurdle.

races.paceDynamic: Rebel Queen will take them along at a sustainable gallop from the front with no obvious pressure early. The real congestion comes from four horses wanting prominent positions - Poetic Twist, Luciole Des Bordes, Giorgia Rose and Northernlightsky - creating traffic dangers from 2-3 out as they fight for racing room. The sustained pace over 2m5½f will test stamina reserves, with the race likely to become a war of attrition in the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and pick off tired leaders, with prominent runners facing positioning battles that will blunt their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet gets bunched and interferes with each other approaching the business end
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable as tired horses wander off true lines, creating gaps for closers. Muted Melody and Mysilverriverfeale can exploit the chaos with late runs while the early pace-pressured horses fade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Poetic Twist Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Twist secures an uncontested prominent position and avoids early traffic
scenarios.body: Her superior RPR of 125 and proven form at the trip allows her to kick clear when others falter. The Elliott yard's timing and Ewing's positioning skills prove decisive over lesser-rated rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mullins Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Ice Breeze Baby shows natural jumping ability and benefits from the strong pace up front
scenarios.body: Debutants often spring surprises in mares' maidens when they have the right connections. The sustained gallop sets up perfectly for an unexposed horse with stamina breeding to strike late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Running Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Queen gets an uncontested lead and the field fails to close the gap
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too sedate for the hold-up horses to make up ground effectively. Motherway's mare gets first run on her rivals and holds on grimly despite carrying less weight.

watchPoints.text: Poetic Twist, Luciole Des Bordes, Giorgia Rose and Northernlightsky create a four-way battle for prominent positions that could compromise all their chances
Ice Breeze Baby's market moves will reveal stable confidence on debut for connections with minimal recent runners
Rebel Queen's fractions in the opening half-mile determine whether hold-up horses get the strong pace they need
Muted Melody's jumping fluency after starting slowly last time, as any early mistakes would negate her tactical advantage
Luciole Des Bordes' settling with the hood after racing too freely in her last start at Clonmel

races.name: Tramore Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Bite That
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course form but hard to fancy on recent hurdles evidence despite winning here previously
runners_data.comment: Soft ground not ideal of late so improvement on the cards back on a sound surface
runners_data.spotlight: Last won over hurdles here (2m, good) in 2022; rated 23lb higher over fences but hard to fancy on the evidence of his last three runs over hurdles at Clonmel.

runners_data.name: Miss Donna
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making handicap debut, third reserve with stamina doubts over this extended trip
runners_data.comment: Last of eight in a m'den here before PU on h'cap bow latest; others more likely
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; glimmers of ability in maiden hurdles including here; weakened over 2m1f (gd-yld) in Wexford handicap hurdle latest; not sure this longer trip will suit on that evidence.

runners_data.name: U Asking Me
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 329-day break, likely needs the run despite decent Clonmel win last time out
runners_data.spotlight: Last won at Clonmel in October 2024 off 4lb lower (2m4f, good); posted a decent effort in a handicap chase when last seen at Wexford last July; likely to need this run.

runners_data.name: Zolpharine
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner exploiting 12lb lower hurdles mark after impressive recent chase win at Limerick
runners_data.comment: Jumping issues when beaten only 4l over 2m at Tramore latest; raise in trip not an issue
runners_data.spotlight: Impressive handicap chase win at Limerick on latest (22.5f, good); now looks to exploit 12lb lower hurdles mark but hasn't won in this sphere since September 2023; in form, though, and can't discount.

runners_data.name: Kilbarry Ce Ce
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good venue form but stamina concerns over this longer trip on breeding
runners_data.spotlight: 0-12; best runs have come at this venue but over shorter trips than this; could run into a place if her stamina holds out (not certain on breeding).

runners_data.name: Brianna Lily
runners_data.note: Prominent type effectively 7lb lower with claim, showed improved form last time at Clonmel
runners_data.comment: Bumper/hurdles winner, last win came two years ago, poor run at Cork on Sunday
runners_data.spotlight: No win since 2023 but step in the right direction when a keeping on 4.75l third at Clonmel (19.5f, gd-yld) 15 days ago; effectively 7lb lower here with rider's claim; stays this far and in the mix with a repeat of that last effort.

runners_data.name: Maxicourt
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with best effort at this venue, but was reluctant at start last time out
runners_data.spotlight: Standout effort came at this venue (2m, yielding) last October when 1 2.25l second to Cousin Kate; hasn't replicated that since and was reluctant at the start at Cork on latest in cheekpieces (discarded); a bit to prove up in trip.

runners_data.name: Clever Court

races.paceDynamic: Not So Serious will lead from the outset with no other confirmed pace-setters, creating a moderate tempo that suits his sustainable style. Bite That and Kilbarry Ce Ce will sit prominently behind the leader, while the bulk of this 19-runner field adopts hold-up tactics including Just For One, Zolpharine, and U Asking Me. The absence of pace pressure means the tempo will be genuine but not frantic, allowing the leader to dictate terms through the early stages before the field closes up approaching the final circuit. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can position close enough to strike, rather than pure hold-up horses who will face a wall of horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Not So Serious maintains a steady tempo without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows prominent runners to travel well and kick clear before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenges. Front-runners and those tracking the pace get first run and hold off late rallies.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Field Bunches Late Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace allows the field to remain tightly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where horses with the best finishing kick and clear runs prevail over position. Those with tactical speed from mid-division can exploit gaps as the early leaders fade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Messy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Not So Serious goes too slowly and the field crawls along before a mad scramble
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with traffic problems and horses getting hampered in a cavalry charge finish. Bold front-runners who commit early can steal a march before chaos ensues.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Leader Folds Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Not So Serious stops quickly and prominent trackers also struggle to handle the trip
scenarios.body: The race falls apart for those who positioned themselves close to the pace, opening the door for deep closers who stayed out of trouble. Patient hold-up horses with stamina get their chance in a truly-run contest.

watchPoints.text: Not So Serious is first reserve so check declarations as the confirmed pace-setter may not even run
Watch for market support for Katie's Casper whose yard has hit form and may have needed recent comeback run
Monitor Just For One's price as he has winning course form and breeding to handle this extended trip
Several runners including Clever Court and Strand Street Lass have pulled up recently and could exit mid-race
Watch the start for Maxicourt who was reluctant last time and any delay could impact his prominent position

races.paceDynamic: Doyen Magic will take this race forward as the only confirmed leader, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure early. The prominent runners Playtime, The Monkey Pole, and Figero should track close behind, while the hold-up horses Splashing Out, Eastmore, and Stepdance will need to rely on the pace quickening late. With no pace pressure on Doyen Magic through the early stages, this sets up perfectly for prominent racers and those who can position handy, as the kick may come too late for the genuine hold-up horses to make their ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners track Doyen Magic smoothly and kick approaching the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows handy horses to save energy for a sustained finish, catching the tiring leader. Playtime and The Monkey Pole are ideally positioned to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Sustains Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Doyen Magic maintains her rhythm and sees out the trip strongly
scenarios.body: The absence of pace pressure early allows her to dictate terms throughout and hold late challengers at bay. Her recent hurdles win and proven stamina become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from two out and creates a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The faster finish allows the back markers to unleash their kick with Splashing Out and Eastmore using superior class. Their patient tactics pay dividends in a genuinely run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stepdance Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the De Bromhead mare benefits from the break and class tells
scenarios.body: Her handicap debut off a workable mark combined with stable confidence creates an upset opportunity. The sustained gallop suits her proven middle-distance ability perfectly.

watchPoints.text: Doyen Magic setting too slow a pace early, which would eliminate the hold-up horses' chances completely
Figero's tendency to fade in the finish, particularly if the pace becomes truly testing from two out
The Monkey Pole's jumping under pressure, given his recent below-par efforts in easier company
Stepdance's fitness after the long break, despite De Bromhead's usual preparation standards
Playtime's ability to recapture March form, as recent handicap runs suggest confidence may be fragile

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runner in this Ladies Pro/Am flat race, the field will drift into a steady tempo through the early stages. The lack of natural pace-setters means this will develop into a sprint finish over the final 3-4 furlongs at Tramore. Hold-up horses like Highlander Addict and One Day In May can position themselves perfectly for late challenges. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can quicken off a modest gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Modest Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If no horse takes up the running early and the field bunches up through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test turning into a sprint where class tells in the final furlong. Hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks will benefit most from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Steady Tempo Grind
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lesser fancied runners takes them along at an even pace throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes more of a staying test where horses that can sustain their effort will prevail. Those with previous bumper experience over similar distances gain the edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: False Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If early leaders set unsustainable fractions before falling away dramatically
scenarios.body: The field compresses entering the straight allowing lightly-raced improvers to strike. Newcomers with potential can exploit the chaotic finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Motion Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is dawdling throughout with everyone still in contention at the furlong pole
scenarios.body: Raw stamina becomes paramount in a war of attrition to the line. Experience and proven form become crucial factors.

Lincoln Mill showed clear promise in points but may find this trip on the sharp side for his staying profile
One Day In May relies heavily on her point form translating as her Wexford third was 17 lengths behind the winner
The trainer statistics show poor 14-day form across most connections which suggests this is a weak renewal
